title: Does the new shape fit?
hints: A reshape is allowed when both shapes hold the same number of elements. The number of axes does not matter.
count already gives the number of elements in a shape. Call it on both shapes.
prompt: Your compiler has to reject a bad reshape. count(shape) is written: it multiplies the sizes of a shape. can_reshape(old_shape, new_shape) should return True when a value of shape old_shape can be reshaped to new_shape. Right now it compares how many axes the two shapes have, which is the wrong test. Fix it.

answer.explain: A reshape keeps every element, so it is allowed exactly when the two shapes have the same element count: count(old_shape) == count(new_shape). The rank is free to change, which is why [6] can become [2, 3]. The empty shape is a scalar. Its count is 1, because count starts from 1, so [1] can become [].
